simple.summary: הַדָּבָר (haddâbâr) means a vizier First listed occurrence: Dan 3 24.

definitions.full: H1907. haddabar [ הַדָּבַר ] noun masculine counsellor, minister (Persian loan-word; original form and meaning dubious, compare Andr M 60* Mey Entst. J. 23 Dr Dan 3:24 ); — plural emphatic הַדָּֽבְרַיָּא 6:8 ; construct הַדָּֽבְרֵי 3:27 ; suffix הַדָּֽבְרַי 4:33 , ר֫וֺהִי - 3:24 . — see גְּדָֽבְרַיָּא .
